paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 5:1: Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha, Rabbi Alexa, in the name of Chizkiyah.

notes.text: Hyman lists Yaakov bar Acha and Alexa consecutively without a connector; their exact transmission relationship is not spelled out.

The saved named Guggenheimer Ketubot 5:1 paragraph reproduces Yaakov bar Acha, Alexa, in the name of Chizkiyah consecutively, without a connecting בשם between the first two. A successive-transmission interpretation is possible but is not supplied as an explicit link. The existing unconnected English and source hold remain.

Hyman’s printed entry (vol. I, p. 158) has the heading “Rabbi Alexa.” Both the Guggenheimer and Machon Mamre texts of Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:1 keep Yaakov bar Acha and Alexa together without a connecting phrase. The explanatory Daat presentation gives the likely reading: Yaakov bar Acha reports in the name of Alexa, who reports in the name of Chizkiyah.
